tidbit: Did you know… about 13,000 new articles reached our newsroom in the last 24 hours.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
OpenAI's funding target dropped by 10 billion dollars as the artificial intelligence sector slows, reported by Bloomberg.
Reported by Fortune: Anthropic's CEO once raised concerns about artificial intelligence systems becoming too autonomous. Barnes and Noble is expanding to 700 stores under new leadership.
Joe Mazzulla, the Celtics coach, uses artificial intelligence every day to improve his coaching strategies, reported by Yahoo Sports.
A malicious Claude Code extension version 2.1.313 deployed an SSH backdoor on approximately 5,000 users' machines, reported by NewsCord.
Apple launches Apple Intelligence in China in December, working with Alibaba Qwen and available on new iPhone models, reported by TechJuice.
Free every hour.
